content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients have rheumatoid arthritis on record?
I'll check the clinical records database for rheumatoid arthritis patients.

This is an OMOP CDM database. Rheumatoid arthritis is standardly represented by SNOMED concept 80809 (which rolls up many descendant codes). I'll count distinct patients using the concept ancestor hierarchy so all RA subtypes are included.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS ra_patients
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 80809
)

content.text:
**19,126 patients** have rheumatoid arthritis on record.

This counts distinct patients with any condition occurrence coded as RA, using the SNOMED hierarchy (ancestor concept 80809) so all RA subtypes and descendant codes are included.
